description: The Category model already has a parent_id column but nothing in the app uses it. Wire up one-level hierarchy: Categories page gets a parent dropdown, budget_calc rolls up spending to parents, alerts fire on parent total or leaf, transactions assign to leaves only. Design doc: pattern #2 (one-level parent/child) from the mental-model discussion. Defer unless a flat list stops being enough.
title: Category hierarchy (parent/child)
